description: HR-42 is the regional transport code for Ganaur, a significant town and tehsil in the Sonipat district of Haryana. The office, administered by the Sub-Divisional Magistrate, manages vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and transport safety enforcement for the Ganaur sub-division.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Railway Road, Ganaur, Sonipat, Haryana
